notes.title: New Demo Update Out Now - All Aboard the Clawville Express!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/bf4c98915813de24c7e59e9afbbaf19d7f6ed807.png[/img]

[h3]Welcome back, detectives. [/h3]
[i]Step aboard the Clawville Express again, as we have new suspects for you to investigate and other interesting things to explore![/i]

Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville demo has now been updated to a new extended demo, which you can play right now. Come aboard the Clawville Express and explore the mystery with additional story scenes and several improvements. Piece things together using your wits, sharp senses, or even a bit of banter. After all, you’re the slyest detectives in the Wilderness.

[h3]Watch the new extended demo trailer here! [/h3]
[previewyoutube=ATdA5u5I12k;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Here’s what’s new in the Extended Demo:[/h3]

[h3]Who killed the ambassador? [/h3]
Additional story scenes that build up the murder incident and connect to the full game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/9c515e8b0a5b4ed1ab2662130c823fb27251f77a.png[/img]

[h3]New faces bring new suspects to investigate.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/b26a94071825cf5c8156bdfd25951f18afcfcc43.png[/img]

[h3]Smoother navigation through the Clawville Express.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/662ae713e8be10abb100b560307b5f9fcf873e36.png[/img]

[h3]Remember not to get too comfy, detectives. You’re here to solve the case![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/413bf4ef771b718be1a9faeafa3cc8c87a6cf90c.png[/img]

[h3]Also, fully voiced cutscenes have been added to deepen the storytelling![/h3]

Thank you for all your support. It’s been a while, and it’s amazing to see the Wilderness community continue to grow. It motivates us to put even more effort into the game. In the meantime, don’t forget to follow us on social media for the latest updates.

Stay tuned, and look forward to the next announcement!

notes.title: Event Recaps with Moses & Plato: Making Stops Before Reaching Clawville!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/7dd53748e0d7062b3bb0024f9eecf4517085a540.png[/img]
[h2] Moses & Plato making stops around the globe before the year ends![/h2]

[h3]Welcome aboard, detectives.[/h3]
[b]Moses & Plato making their appearance worldwide through multiple gaming events.[/b]

Early this year, we announced Moses & Plato : Last Train to Clawville during Toge Productions' Anniversary Event. It's been an amazing year for us, as we came to multiple places to introduce Moses & Plato for the trainee detectives who will soon help us solve the case. Thank you to everyone who have visited us during gaming conventions and trying out the demo.

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1826922086310543846]Visiting PAX West[/url] for the first time in 2024. [/h2]
Back in August 30th - Sept 2nd 2024, located in Seattle Convention Center, we visited PAX West 2024 under Toge Productions booth. Being one of the title published by Toge Productions, we showcased Moses & Plato at the front of the booth. The demo is well-received, and everyone is excited for the release. There are some excited trainee detectives who played quite long than others. The demo also include a minigame that some people find interesting to play with. We also had our volunteers to help us during the event which helped us a lot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/2197f2200ffb7864f5f2e988053c0be6b50522fc.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1841813395701694559]Level Up KL 2024[/url]: We got nominated and received an award![/h2]
We attended Level Up KL from October 1-3 at the Kuala Lumpur Convention Center. As one of Southeast Asia's biggest annual gaming events, Level Up KL showcases and nominates new and upcoming games. It was an honor to represent The Wild Gentlemen and receive the Best International Award Silver. The developers are excited by this recognition, motivating them to continue bringing the best from The World of Wilderness universe.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/fb3516864c55d469033a3089e193db8f8f7ac118.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1844698659323298272]PAX Aus 2024[/url]: Another first time visit for Moses & Plato.[/h2]
It's been a while since Toge Productions visited PAX Australia, but this year we have the opportunity to come back. The event happened on 11 - 13 October, at Melbourne Convention Centre. We were also tried making Moses & Plato at the front of our booth so it's easier for attendees to spot and trying out the demo. It's a fun experience for us to talk with many people lining up and curious asking about the title. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/17bf188faa208eb8797b1c229138883f9eada172.png[/img]

[h3]One of our volunteers interacting with the attendees. [/h3]
One of our community members helping us during our PAX Australia. Shout out to Hak who have been following us over the years!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/b77965bc77bc9948238063b6a6fa427855eb80c8.jpg[/img]

[h2][url=https://x.com/togeproductions/status/1847811005893730792]Gamescom Asia 2024[/url]: The lastest event we attended this year.[/h2]
In addition to visiting Gamescom Cologne this year, we also attended Gamescom Asia at the Suntec Convention Center from October 17-20, 2024. While the event was smaller compared to Gamescom Cologne, the excitement was just as high. This was our first time bringing Moses & Plato to Gamescom Asia together with other another Toge Productions' title. Despite knowing the venue's dim lighting, attendees were deeply focused on playing the demo. Nonetheless, the demo was well-received by everyone trying it out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/941a09bd31f041fa95f67e2d2203c9e003fe4389.jpg[/img]

[h2]That is all. See you next year![/h2]
It’s been an incredible ride bringing Moses & Plato: Last Train to Clawville to detectives around the world. Stay tuned! We hope to share some exciting news soon! As the year comes to a close.. we will see you again next year!

notes.title: Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! - is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/77954bfbd860fcf6765cfdfff336d4cce19f4d1a.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Another story from the World of Wilderness...[/b][/h2]

Chicken Police: Into the HIVE! is a classic noir story that is both dark, deep, and absurdly funny at the same time. A story of friendship, love, crime... and chickens?!

Sonny Featherland and Marty MacChicken are perhaps Clawville's most famous detectives, who also happen to be colleagues and rivals of our heroes: Moses and Plato. The two roosters become embroiled in a worldwide conspiracy that they must uncover and solve - even at the cost of their lives!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/f7629b55169d0bbed1de0e5a7faeeadb544e89ee.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/93b3980b5f64de643d9ad3f19600a59cdffdd75d.jpg[/img]

A special bonus for Moses & Plato fans is that our two beloved protagonists also appear in Chicken Police, and play a very important and big part in the story. (both in noir and in glorious technicolor mode!)

Check out the game, grab it if it's tickles you fancy, or try the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

So long, detectives!
[i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

notes.title: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville Demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/5ad10018ef3caeba1fd35580d004a874993f4577.png[/img]

[h3]Welcome aboard, detectives.[/h3]

Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville demo is now available on Steam. You can play the demo without any limited-time restriction. Step into the shoes of the best detectives in all the Widlerness: Moses, the sly fox with great senses to sniff out clues, and his trustworthy companion Plato, who is always there when something's wrong.  

If you haven't checked out our latest trailer, check it out here!
[previewyoutube=zTlsfYb9Rpc;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo is partially voiced, with familiar faces from the previous games of the Wilderness universe. Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville demo also features a new mechanics to add more interesting way to solve the mystery and know what's going on before the main story take part. Meet some of the new characters that also introduced before the Clawville Express tragedy happened. 

You can try the demo as many times as you like, as there are some parts that you cannot obtain just in one run. Seek all the possible clues which lead to the truth of the passengers. You are free to do as what you like in the demo, as there are different clues to solve a problem with only a spare amount of time to choose your actions.

We are looking forward for your feedback. At the studio, we are still on polishing the final build before it's finally released. Please do join our community if you're excited to talk about the game, or to get contact directly with the developers.

See you all real soon on the final train schedule.

notes.title: Moses and Plato - Last Train to Clawville Steam Page is Now Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837762/a8817f41d1453cd322e06aeed41ecaa4925f5c1e.png[/img]
[h3][b]Welcome aboard, Detectives. [/b][/h3]

[i][h3]Step into the shoes of the Wilderness' most cunning detectives, Moses and Plato, and unravel the mystery of the Clawville Express as the wrongly accused main suspect before time runs out. [/h3][/i]
From the minds behind Chicken Police and Zipp’s Cafe, in the continuously expanding universe of 'World of Wilderness,' emerges a new murder mystery adventure game featuring Moses – the snobbish fox detective, and his partner Plato – a fierce yet comical cat. 

Everything goes sour when the ambassador they are supposed to keep an eye on is killed, and Moses is framed for the whole ordeal. It’s up to you to clear the name before time ticks out when the Clawville Express reaches its destination. If not, a rift may emerge between the powers of the Wilderness, leading to the outbreak of war!

[i]Check the video trailer right here![/i]
[previewyoutube=_ltdAugNFiw;full][/previewyoutube]

Moses and Plato - Last Train to Clawville is a hybrid point-and-click and visual novel investigative adventure where you must race against time to sniff out the real murderer. Be the slyest fox detective and find a killer in a race against time. 

Time will continue to progress as you spot clues using your animal instincts, converse with the diverse cast of figures, and eavesdrop on a seemingly harmless conversation. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? If not, war can break out between the two biggest powers of the Wilderness!
